as_told.title: Eric Weinstein on a secret US physics program

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says the researcher Eric Weinstein came to this subject because he became convinced there was a secret branch of physics in the 1950s to 1970s. According to Michels, it involved well-known physicists John Wheeler, Richard Feynman and Bryce DeWitt, who had much more contact with private aerospace companies than met the eye. If true, it would mean some advanced physics was quietly kept out of public science.
